test_results.name: Champion Distinction Law
test_results.description: Different champions must have separated embedding vectors in Champ2Vec

test_results.name: Star Progression Monotonicity
test_results.description: Upgrades must progress along the star embedding manifold

test_results.name: Item Vector Divergence Law
test_results.description: A board with 9 completed items must cause significant vector separation from 0 items

trunk.diagnosis: MultiModalFusionTrunk exhibits severe Item Feature Collapse: identical boards with 9 completed items versus 0 items have cos_sim = 0.9641 (96.4% identical). The transformer attention and trait projection drown out item representations.

test_results.name: Mirror Match Identity Law
test_results.description: P(Board A beats Board A) must strictly evaluate to 50.0%

test_results.name: Anti-Symmetry Law
test_results.description: Combat resolver must be mathematically anti-symmetric across focal/opponent swap
test_results.law: P(A vs B) + P(B vs A) == 100.0%

test_results.name: Unit Count Dominance Law
test_results.description: 9 units (2-star) must overwhelmingly crush 3 units (1-star)

test_results.name: Star Level Dominance Law
test_results.description: Full 3-star composition must consistently defeat an identical 1-star composition

test_results.name: Item Advantage Law
test_results.description: An identical composition equipped with 9 completed meta items must overwhelmingly defeat 0 items

details.heuristic_comparison: HeuristicCombatResolver yields 368.3 power vs 136.1 power (x2.71 multiplier)

test_results.name: Champion Cost Dominance Law
test_results.description: Full 4-cost / 5-cost composition must overpower a 1-cost composition of equal stars

combat_resolver.diagnosis: DeepSiameseCombatNet fails the Item Advantage Law (51.47% vs required >= 80%). Because item embeddings have low gradient magnitude in the interaction MLP, combat resolution treats items as negligible, preventing RL agents from learning that itemizing carries wins games.

test_results.name: Endgame Composition Separation Law
test_results.description: A capped Stage 5 Level 9 board must predict a substantially superior finish than an early weak board

test_results.name: Star Upgrade Placement Benefit Law
test_results.description: Upgrading an entire board from 1-star to 3-star must meaningfully improve placement

test_results.name: Itemization Placement Benefit Law
test_results.description: Equipping 9 completed meta items on carries/tanks must improve expected placement

test_results.name: Health Buffer Survival Law
test_results.description: At identical boards, a player with 100 HP must have a strictly higher Top-4 probability than a player at 12 HP

board_quality.diagnosis: BoardQualityNet fails the Itemization Benefit Law (Delta = +0.02 places). The oracle predicts almost the exact same tournament placement regardless of whether a team has 9 items or 0 items.

test_results.name: Non-Identity Dynamics Law
test_results.description: World Model must predict non-zero transition dynamics (must not output identity copy of input)

test_results.name: Autoregressive Rollout Stability Law
test_results.description: Multi-step recursive lookahead must not explode towards infinity or collapse to zero

test_results.name: Residual Transition Magnitude Law
test_results.description: Predicted change delta must have measurable non-zero Euclidean magnitude

test_results.name: Archetype Orthogonality Law
test_results.description: Target archetypes must represent distinctly separated strategic comps

test_results.name: Centroid Non-Degeneracy Law
test_results.description: All k cluster centroids must possess non-trivial vector magnitude

test_results.name: Model Object & Inference Interface
test_results.description: MatchEloRegressor deserializes cleanly and exposes competitive predict_match interface

test_results.name: Action Mask Enforcement Law
test_results.description: Illegal masked actions must receive mathematically zero probability mass

test_results.name: Health Monotonicity Value Law
test_results.description: Higher health buffer must reflect higher expected cumulative return V(s)

test_results.name: Board Size Value Monotonicity Law
test_results.description: A 9-unit full board must evaluate to a strictly higher expected return than a 3-unit board

test_results.name: Critic Item Sensitivity Law
test_results.description: The critic value function V(s) must appreciate the massive combat value of 9 completed items

actor_critic.diagnosis: TFTActorCritic Critic head fails the Item Sensitivity Law (Delta = -0.0374). The value function estimates zero additional cumulative reward for having 9 completed meta items, meaning PPO receives no gradient incentive to prioritize itemizing units.
